name: Interac e-Transfer
description: CAD business transfer using the registered receiving email and payee.
setup: Enter the email registered with your business bank and its exact payee. Enable only for permitted business use.
settlement: Check the bank for actual receipt; an email or screenshot is not payment confirmation.

name: Bank transfer
description: Transfer to a configured business bank account in the invoice currency.
setup: Enter bank-issued incoming-payment instructions and beneficiary. Create separate entries for USD and CAD accounts.
settlement: Reconcile the bank transaction reference and invoice amount before marking paid.

name: PayPal
description: PayPal Business hosted invoice; eligible payment choices are shown by PayPal.
setup: Use a business account eligible for the exact products and customer transaction. Attach a separate exact-amount PayPal invoice, not PayPal.Me or friends-and-family payments.
settlement: Check the paid business invoice and any holds directly in PayPal before recording receipt.

name: Cards via Stripe
description: A Stripe-hosted invoice from an eligible activated business account.
setup: Confirm account and product eligibility, including applicable research-buyer controls. Use an exact-amount hosted invoice. This does not restart the retired legacy checkout.
settlement: Check the invoice payment in Stripe. A customer return page is not payment confirmation.

name: Bitcoin via BTCPay Server
description: Bitcoin checkout on your configured BTCPay Server invoice page.
setup: Provide your running HTTPS BTCPay hostname with a working store and receiving wallet. Create an invoice with the exact fiat accounting amount; the server quotes the Bitcoin amount.
settlement: Require the BTCPay invoice to settle. Review partial, late, wrong-network or excess payments separately. Never paste a seed phrase or private key.

name: Crypto via NOWPayments
description: Crypto payment through a configured NOWPayments invoice.
setup: Connect an eligible merchant account and verified payout destination in NOWPayments, then use its exact-invoice payment URL. Fiat/card on-ramps are separate provider services, not approval-free card acquiring.
settlement: Confirm the completed payment and exact invoice value in the provider; reconcile asset/network fees and exceptions separately.

name: Priority approved processor
description: Your approved specialist processor's hosted invoice or payment page.
setup: Use the approved provider's exact hostname and beneficiary. Once available, set its priority above backup methods without changing existing invoices.
settlement: Confirm payment in that provider and record its unique transaction reference.
